comment: HUD shell colours per skin. Each skin is a few seeds; every other shell colour (text, captions, accents, outlines, panel fill, Orbit series, media-screen backing) is derived from them and pulled to readable contrast (text >= 4.5:1, outlines >= 3:1) against "surface", the mean colour of the skin's panels. mode: "dark" = light text on dark panels, "light" = dark ink on light panels. secondary is optional (defaults to primary). overrides pins a token (primary, secondary, accent, muted, caption, warning, dataA, dataB) to an exact colour, skipping the contrast fit. Colours are #RRGGBB. A skin with no entry keeps the built-in day/night palette. Only the HUD shell reads this file; widgets inside sketch scenes are not themed yet.
